dialogues.speaker: Paqarin
dialogues.text: Hey, you over there! ...That's right, you!

dialogues.speaker: Paqarin
dialogues.text: You've got such a spring in your step, and the speed you run... It's clear you're pretty strong, like someone who works out.

dialogues.speaker: Paqarin
dialogues.text: Are you one of our warriors from the Collective of Plenty? Or from another tribe perhaps?

response.speaker: Paqarin
response.text: I see, that's too bad. *sigh* Ah well, I guess having someone show up to help right when you need them most is the kind of luck you only find in dreams.

response.speaker: Paqarin
response.text: Well, I've got a farm here, as I'm sure you've noticed.

response.speaker: Paqarin
response.text: I've always managed this farm on my own, but I've been a bit down on my luck lately...

response.speaker: Paqarin
response.text: A few days ago, I got into a wrestling match with a warrior from the tribe and ended up hurting my back. Yeah, I know, it was a pretty stupid thing to do...

response.speaker: Paqarin
response.text: As a result, not only can't I help my old pa clear new fields, I can't even manage my own farm. To be honest, right now, even just walking hurts.

response.speaker: Paqarin
response.text: I was just thinking of hiring someone to help out for a few days when you came along.

response.speaker: Paqarin
response.text: It's a pity you're only passing by. Farm work requires daily effort and care, so if you're only here once in a while, my crops will end up going to waste.

response.speaker: Paqarin
response.text: But right now, I don't have the strength to travel all the way to the tribe to find someone. *sigh* Aside from the few little Tatankasaurs I've raised, there's really no one else around to help.

response.speaker: Paqarin
response.text: Those little troublemakers have been acting up these past few days. All three of them have just been lazing about in the fields, and won't even come back to me.

response.speaker: Paqarin
response.text: If you would do me a small favor, could you please bring them back? I'm finding it very hard to walk.

response.speaker: Paqarin
response.text: Thanks, I really appreciate it. They're usually quite well-behaved and often keep me company when I'm working in the fields. I'm not sure what's gotten into them these past few days...

response.speaker: Paqarin
response.text: If you call out to them, I'm sure... I mean, fairly sure that my three little saurians will come back of their own accord.

choices.text: I'm not from Natlan at all.

dialogues.speaker: Paqarin
dialogues.text: All three of my little ones are back now. It must be thanks to you.

dialogues.speaker: Paqarin
dialogues.text: Thank you for your kindness, valiant passerby.

dialogues.speaker: Paqarin
dialogues.text: My back still hurts, but nevertheless, it feels a lot better having my little saurians around again.

dialogues.speaker: Paqarin
dialogues.text: I'm not particularly wealthy, but I can still offer you a small reward. Please, take these as a token of my gratitude.

dialogues.speaker: Paqarin
dialogues.text: Would you mind heading over to the fields to see if you can find my <color=#00E1FFFF>three little saurians</color>? Please, bring them back to me.
